content.t: Wombourne Allstars was founded in 2020 by like minded volunteers who possessed a desire to launch a proper youth football club in Wombourne, for the good of the community, and the children within the local area.

A lack of a proper club meant that kids who wanted to play in football clubs at league level were signposted to teams outside of Wombourne, which was a shame for a village that once was very football focused!
So the hard work began.

The club’s vision started to come to fruition. Driven by a passion for football and a necessity to help the local area, friends were called, people chipped in, and despite the pandemic sending the world crazy, things started to REALLY get going.
As the club grew and exceeded what was expected, a committee was formed, building the foundations of a club that started from nothing.

Standards were set such as; respecting the rights, dignity and worth of each person, treating each equally in the context of sport and placing the well-being and safety of each player above all other considerations, including performance.

Our story is still missing several chapters, as we move forwards. We have lots of exciting things in the pipeline, and we want to achieve the very best for all of our players, coaches, staff AND the wider community. If you think you can volunteer, we would love to hear from you.
We will be trialling new initiatives from time to time and all of our announcements will be available on social media, newsletter and our news pages online.

blocks.text: Looking to coach at Wombourne Allstars?

content.t: We are always looking for coaching talent to help coach our teams thrive.

blocks.text: Join Wombourne Allstars FC as a Volunteer Coach!

content.t: Are you passionate about football? Want to make a real difference in your community? Wombourne Allstars FC is looking for dedicated volunteers to step into grassroots coaching and help develop the next generation of young footballers!

Becoming a volunteer coach is more than just football—it’s about inspiring young players, building confidence, and shaping the future of the sport in our local area. Whether you’re an experienced coach or just starting out, we provide everything you need to get going!
FA Coaching Qualification Support
– by the end of your second year coaching with us, you will have been credited with the full amount of your coaching course costs from the FA.
First Aid & DBS Certification
– We fund essential first aid courses and cover the cost of your DBS check so you can coach with confidence.
Starter Equipment & Coaching Attire
– Get kitted out with all the essentials to run fun and engaging training sessions.
Mentorship & Support
– You won’t be alone! Our experienced coaching team will guide and support you as you grow into your role.
Make a Difference
– Help young players aged 6-16 and beyond develop their skills, teamwork, and love for football.
Community & Camaraderie
– Be part of a club that values its volunteers and fosters a fantastic footballing environment.

Anyone with a passion for the game! Whether you’re a parent, former player, student, or just someone who loves football, we welcome individuals of all experience levels. If you’re eager to learn and inspire young players, we want you on board!
Ready to take the next step? Join our coaching team and make a lasting impact on youth football in Wombourne. Get in touch with us today to learn more and start your coaching journey!
Contact us; contact@wombourneallstars.co.uk
Be part of something special—become a coach at Wombourne Allstars FC!

content.t: Wombourne Allstars FC ("the Club", "we", "us") takes your privacy very seriously. This notice explains what personal data we collect, why we need it, who we share it with, how long we keep it and what your rights are.
The Club is a volunteer-run grassroots football club in Wombourne, Staffordshire, run by its committee. We are the data controller, responsible for the personal data described in this notice.
Contact us:
email
contact@wombourneallstars.co.uk
or use the contact form on our website. For anything about a child's safety, contact our Club Welfare Officers at
safeguarding@wombourneallstars.co.uk

items.t: players of all ages, in our youth, girls', adult and walking football teams, and children who come to taster sessions, Mini Stars or club events;
parents, guardians and emergency contacts;
coaches, team managers, volunteers and committee members;
people who join our waiting list or the 100 Club, or buy from our online shop;
sponsors, people who contact us, visitors to our website and users of the Allstars app.

content.t: Personal data means any information about a person from which they can be identified. Depending on how you are involved with the Club, we may hold the following.
Your ASTRO account.
ASTRO is the Club's registration system on our website. For parents, guardians and adult members it holds:

items.t: your name, email address, phone number, the first line of your address and your postcode;
your occupation category, which the FA asks accredited clubs to collect to help keep the game inclusive (you can choose "Decline to state");
your employer or business, only if you choose to tell us;
your sign-in details. Passwords are stored scrambled (hashed), so nobody can read them.

content.t: Players:

items.t: name, date of birth, school, team or teams, and season;
a head-and-shoulders photo, which we need to register players with the FA and our leagues;
registration and payment status;
whether you agree to photos and videos for club media, and whether your child is subject to family, care or legal proceedings that mean they must not be photographed.

content.t: Emergency contacts:
name and phone number, and their occupation and employer if you give them.
Health information:

health needs, medication, any medical training our coaches need, and access and communication needs. This is special category data. We only hold it with the explicit consent of the player or, for a child, their parent or guardian, so that we can keep them safe and look after their wellbeing.
Payments:

items.t: monthly subscriptions and what they are made up of, Direct Debit payment dates and amounts, whether each payment succeeded, and GoCardless reference numbers;
Direct Debits are set up with GoCardless. We never see or store your bank account details.

content.t: Waiting list:

if you register interest for a child, your name, relationship to the child, email and phone number, and the child's name, date of birth, postcode, age group, football experience and any disabilities or additional needs you choose to tell us about.
Taster sessions, Mini Stars and events:
the child's name, the parent or guardian's name and contact details, an emergency contact, and consents.
Coaches, team managers, volunteers and committee members:
contact details, role and teams, and the status of FA qualifications, safeguarding training and DBS (criminal record) checks, which are carried out and recorded through the FA.
100 Club:
your name, contact details, the numbers you hold and your payments. Members' names are shown against their numbers on the 100 Club page of our website.
Online shop:
your name, delivery address, email address, phone number and what you ordered. Card payments are taken by WooPayments, which uses Stripe. We never see your full card details.
Messages:
messages you send us through our contact forms or by email, and the club messages and team news we send you.
Website and app:

sign-in and security records, including your internet (IP) address. When you give or change a consent in ASTRO, we record the date and the IP address it was given from. See also "Cookies and website analytics" and "The Allstars app" below.

blocks.text: Why we use your personal data

content.t: We only use personal data for the purpose it was given for. Mainly, we need it to run the football club and arrange matches, to administer memberships and to provide the services you sign up for when you register.
The table below sets out the ways we use personal data and the lawful basis for each under the UK GDPR.

rows.t: Purpose
Lawful basis
Registering players and members, running teams, training and matches, and collecting subscriptions
Performance of a contract (your membership)
Registering players, coaches and teams with the FA (Whole Game System), Birmingham County FA and our leagues
Performance of a contract
Sending club messages, team news and match information by email and through the Allstars app
Performance of a contract. App notifications are only sent if you allow them on your phone.
Holding health information to keep players safe
Explicit consent. In an emergency, to protect someone's vital interests.
Safeguarding, including DBS checks and making sure children who must not be photographed are not
Legitimate interests in keeping children safe, and the safeguarding condition in the Data Protection Act 2018
Photos and videos of players on our website and social media, and match reports that name players
Consent. For a child, the consent of a parent or guardian. You can withdraw it at any time.
Occupation category for the FA's inclusion figures
Consent: you can choose "Decline to state"
Your employer, so we can explore local sponsorship
Legitimate interests in finding sponsors to keep subscriptions down. Giving it is optional.
The waiting list
Consent
Committee members contacting members about club activities, renewals and social events
Legitimate interests in keeping in touch with our members and club community

Consent, or as an existing member unless you have told us you don't want them
Sharing anonymised numbers with funding partners such as the local authority, or as evidence of local demand for pitches
Legitimate interests in running the Club and applying for funding
The 100 Club and online shop orders
Performance of a contract
Keeping the website and app secure, and understanding how the website is used
Legitimate interests in running a safe, working website

content.t: If we need personal data to meet our responsibilities and you don't provide it, we may not be able to register you or administer your membership.

blocks.text: Who we share your personal data with

items.t: The FA, Birmingham County FA and our leagues

, to register players, coaches and teams and for affiliation. Coaches and volunteers are entered onto the FA's Whole Game System, and players may be too, depending on the league. Data on the Whole Game System is also covered by the FA's own privacy policy.
Coaches, team managers and committee members
, only what they need for their role. Coaches see the players in their own teams, including the emergency contacts and health information needed to keep them safe.
Referees, match organisers and facility providers
, when needed to run matches and events.
Anyone we must share it with by law
, or to protect the rights, property or safety of our players, members or others.

content.t: We also use these service providers, who may only use your personal data as we instruct:

items.t: SiteGround hosts our website, ASTRO and the Allstars app's data;
GoCardless collects our Direct Debits, for subscriptions, the 100 Club and walking football;
WooPayments (Stripe) takes card payments in our online shop;
Google provides Google Analytics on our website;
Expo, Apple and Google deliver notifications to the Allstars app;
Meta publishes the team news and photos we post on the Club's Facebook page. Photos only ever show children whose parents have agreed to photography;
1st Class Coaching runs our Mini Stars sessions with us.

content.t: We never sell your personal data.

The Allstars app is for parents and guardians, players, coaches and committee members. You sign in with the same email address and password as your ASTRO account. Children do not have their own accounts.
What the app shows you.
The app shows information the Club already holds about you and your family in ASTRO, and doesn't ask you for anything new. It shows:

items.t: your name, email address and your role or roles at the Club;

for each of your children registered this season: their name, team, registration status, monthly subscription and what it is made up of, recent and upcoming Direct Debit payments, any amount outstanding, their photography and legal consents, and whether medical and emergency details are on file. The app never shows the medical details themselves;
club messages and team news sent to you, which are also emailed to you;
club news, fixtures, results and club information, which are public on our website anyway.

content.t: To change any details, make a payment or set up a Direct Debit, the app opens the matching page of our website, already signed in. Those pages work exactly as they do on the website.
What the app collects:

items.t: Your sign-in.

When you sign in, we record the phone's model name (for example "iPhone 16"), whether it is an iPhone or Android phone, the app version, and when the sign-in was created and last used. This lets you see and sign out your devices (More, then Signed-in devices) and lets us end a sign-in if your account is closed or your password changes.
Notifications.

If you allow notifications, your phone gives the app a push notification address, which we store with your sign-in so we can tell you about new club messages and team news. You can turn notifications off at any time in your phone's settings.
Your inbox.
We keep a copy of each club message and team news alert sent to you through the app, and whether you have read it.
Failed sign-ins.
To stop people guessing passwords, failed sign-in attempts are counted against the email address and IP address used, for 15 minutes.

content.t: The app does not use advertising, analytics or tracking of any kind. It does not access your location, contacts, camera or photos.
On your phone.

The app keeps only its sign-in key on your phone, in the phone's secure storage (the iPhone Keychain or Android Keystore). Your family's details are loaded from our website each time and are not saved on the phone, and signing out clears them. On iPhone, website pages opened from the app use a private browser session that ends when you return to the app.
Notifications

are passed to your phone by Expo (650 Industries Inc., USA), which runs the service the app uses to send them, and then by Apple or Google. We only send them your phone's push notification address and a short, general message such as "New message from the club" or "New team news for U9 Tigers". Names, medical details and payment details are never put in a notification; you see the full message when you open the app.

Our website uses cookies it needs to work, for example to keep you signed in to ASTRO and to remember your shop basket. It also uses Google Analytics, which sets cookies to count visits and show us which pages are used. Google Analytics doesn't tell us who you are. You can block these cookies in your browser's settings or with Google's opt-out add-on at
tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout
. The Allstars app doesn't use Google Analytics.

Some of our service providers are based in, or use servers in, the USA or Europe, including Google, Meta, Expo and Stripe. Where your personal data is sent outside the UK, it is protected by the safeguards UK law requires, such as the UK–US data bridge or contract terms approved by the Information Commissioner's Office.

blocks.text: How we protect your personal data

content.t: We have put security measures in place to prevent personal data being lost, used or accessed without permission, altered or disclosed:

items.t: ASTRO only shows people what their role needs. Parents see their own family, coaches see their own teams, and medical details are only seen by those who need them.
Our website and the app use encrypted connections, and passwords are stored scrambled.
We never store bank or card details.

blocks.text: How long we keep your personal data

items.t: We keep personal data on players and members while they remain members or are otherwise involved with the Club. We delete it within 90 days of a player or member leaving, or sooner if you ask and we are able to.
Taster session forms are deleted 90 days after the session, unless the child joins the Club.
Waiting list details are kept until your child is offered a place, or until you ask us to remove them.

App sign-ins end after 180 days without use, when you sign out, or when you sign out a device from the app. Ended sign-ins, and the notification address that went with them, are deleted within 30 days. Records of notifications sent are deleted after 30 days. Your app inbox is deleted with your account.
Some records must be kept for longer for legal, accounting, FA or safeguarding reasons, such as payment records and safeguarding concerns.
Personal data on the FA's Whole Game System is kept under the FA's privacy policy, so we suggest you read that policy too. To have your data deleted from the Whole Game System, please contact the FA.

content.t: You may have the right at any time to ask for a copy of your personal data, and to have it corrected or erased. You can also ask us to restrict or stop certain kinds of processing, including direct marketing, and you have the right to data portability.
Where we rely on your consent, you can withdraw it at any time by changing it in ASTRO or telling a committee member. Withdrawing consent for health information may mean a child can't take part.
A child who is old enough to understand their rights (usually from about 12) can make these requests about their own personal data.

You can close your ASTRO account from the Allstars app (More, then Delete my account) or by contacting us. Closing it signs you out everywhere straight away. The Club's registration officer and treasurer then cancel any Direct Debit and delete your personal data as described above.
You don't have to share your personal data with the Club, but if you don't, we may not be able to register you or administer your membership.

If you are unhappy with how we have handled your personal data, please contact us first. You also have the right to complain to the Information Commissioner's Office, the UK's data protection regulator, at
ico.org.uk
We may update this notice from time to time and will tell members about any important changes. If you have any questions about it, please contact us at
contact@wombourneallstars.co.uk
